images.subject: An automated robot factory, one towering multi-level structure anchored into the cliff, with glass-walled assembly floors stacked up its height where giant robotic arms assemble robots under bright light. On the left side of the frame, on the open plain beside the tower, a second large and clearly separate block: a wide low assembly hall with a huge open door and bright lights inside, from which a second line of robots walks out. In the bottom right of the frame, in the foreground on the rocky ground, a third large and clearly separate block: an open-air steel assembly gantry in which a giant heavy-duty robot, taller than the hall, is being built by robotic arms.
images.detail: A line of finished bipedal robots walks out from its base.
